The smoke locks this time walk the function shape AND check for the horizontal-overlap test that makes the right outcome reachable plus an explicit NEGATIVE lock that the unconditional slide-below regression pattern cannot return. The chair test by Kirk remains the authoritative effect verification — Node-side smoke can only verify the structural ingredients are present.
